raw_findings.text: P1 — plugin/runtime.lua:532 maps a scalar marker ID to the last v2 pane seen. Two realms can share a pane ID, so get_attention(id) can return another pane’s state. Return unavailable when that scalar is ambiguous.

P1 — src/records.rs:599 parses an existing v1 plain-text marker as JSON before replacing it with the v2 compatibility projection. An in-place upgrade leaves the stale marker and blocks projection repair.

P2 — pi/index.ts:294 passes an absent launch ID as the literal undefined. Rust rejects it rather than using matching-claim recovery. Direct probe confirmed Node produces WEZTERM_ATTENTION_LAUNCH_ID=undefined.
P2 — plugin/runtime.lua:802 treats a live pane moving from v1 identity to v2 identity as closed, deleting its v1 marker, acknowledgement, agent, and review sidecars.
P2 — plugin/protocol.lua:721 bounds lifecycle.json reads but reads all other v2 records with *a before enforcing max_json_bytes.
P2 — src/compat.rs:201 treats unreadable agent directories or entries as empty, which can erase or undercount the v1 .agents sidecar.
P2 — pi/index.ts:541 retains every queued Pi event behind a permanently blocked state write, with no memory bound.
P2 — src/lib.rs:289 checks mux socket identity before realm publication, but not during its per-pane TTY loop. A socket rebirth can publish a stale realm/incarnation.
P2 — plugin/runtime.lua:366 can retain a closed window’s unpublished-realm retry forever when GUI-window inventory is unavailable.
P2 — docs/record-contract.md:39 says every accepted transition is lock-guarded, while Lua acknowledgement and review operations are only per-file atomic operations.

evidence.observed: C1 returned a realm's view instead of nil after observing two realms with pane 42.

evidence.locator: tests/auto_clear_spec.lua:C1 scalar lookup refuses two full pane addresses; C1 first observation through Alt+B participates in scalar ambiguity; C1 C4 Alt+B replaces the same pane identity without deleting sidecars
evidence.observed: Scalar ambiguity, same-address sharing, overlay-first discovery and same-pane replacement all pass.

records.reachability_basis: Multi-realm panes can share 42 during ordinary use.
records.invariant: Scalar ID lookup must not choose among distinct live full addresses.
records.smallest_complete_fix: Track distinct observed cache-key owners for each scalar and return nil on ambiguity, including overlay refresh.
records.risk_if_fixed_now: Over-broad ambiguity retention could hide state after a pane closes.
records.action: Implemented and focused proof passed. Track distinct observed cache-key owners for each scalar and return nil on ambiguity, including overlay refresh.

evidence.observed: Production Stop failed with record_invalid and left thinking text instead of repairing the projection.
A real provider Stop replaces the existing thinking text marker with the valid compatibility projection.

records.invariant: A valid legacy text marker must remain replaceable by its validated compatibility projection.
records.smallest_complete_fix: Keep strict replacement validation for v2 records; use the v1 projection replacement boundary for flat compatibility output.
records.risk_if_deferred: In-place upgrades preserve stale badges and fail hooks.
records.risk_if_fixed_now: Weakening v2 future-schema preservation by mistake.
records.action: Implemented and focused proof passed. Keep strict replacement validation for v2 records; use the v1 projection replacement boundary for flat compatibility output.

records.observation: P2 — plugin/runtime.lua:802 treats a live pane moving from v1 identity to v2 identity as closed, deleting its v1 marker, acknowledgement, agent, and review sidecars.
records.claimed_consequence: Upgrade/reconnect deletes sidecars for a still-live pane.
records.proposed_remedy: Not supplied separately in the pasted finding.

evidence.observed: C4 deleted the marker when the same GUI pane acquired v2 identity.

evidence.locator: tests/auto_clear_spec.lua:C4 identity publication is not pane destruction; C1 C4 Alt+B replaces the same pane identity without deleting sidecars
evidence.observed: Marker, matching acknowledgement, agents and review sidecars survive identity publication, including through Alt+B.

records.reachability_basis: Normal publication can change cache keys between two polls.
records.invariant: A change in storage identity is not evidence that the GUI pane closed.
records.smallest_complete_fix: Carry GUI-local pane identity through observations and require its absence before deleting legacy sidecars.
records.risk_if_deferred: Upgrade/reconnect deletes sidecars for a still-live pane.
records.risk_if_fixed_now: Over-broad preservation could leak markers for panes that actually closed.
records.action: Implemented and focused proof passed. Carry GUI-local pane identity through observations and require its absence before deleting legacy sidecars.
records.draft_response: Confirmed under the recorded conditions; the complete local correction and focused regressions pass. The full repository gate and isolated timing confirmation now pass.

records.observation: P2 — plugin/protocol.lua:721 bounds lifecycle.json reads but reads all other v2 records with *a before enforcing max_json_bytes.
records.claimed_consequence: Unbounded allocation and polling delay on malformed state.
records.proposed_remedy: Not supplied separately in the pasted finding.

evidence.observed: The claim read requested *a, not maximum plus one.

evidence.locator: tests/auto_clear_spec.lua:C5 every v2 record has a bounded file read
evidence.observed: Core claim reads request max_json_bytes+1; lifecycle reads retain their separate bound and overflow behavior.

records.reachability_basis: Every core v2 read uses this boundary; a large file exposes the consequence.
records.invariant: Known v2 records must be bounded before decoding.
records.smallest_complete_fix: Select max_json_bytes for every non-lifecycle v2 record read, retaining the separate lifecycle bound and overflow classification.
records.risk_if_deferred: Unbounded allocation and polling delay on malformed state.
records.risk_if_fixed_now: Applying v2 limits accidentally to legacy format or manifest loading.
records.action: Implemented and focused proof passed. Select max_json_bytes for every non-lifecycle v2 record read, retaining the separate lifecycle bound and overflow classification.
records.draft_response: Confirmed under the recorded conditions; the complete local correction and focused regressions pass. The full repository gate and isolated timing confirmation now pass.

records.observation: P2 — src/compat.rs:201 treats unreadable agent directories or entries as empty, which can erase or undercount the v1 .agents sidecar.
records.claimed_consequence: False zero/undercount during an I/O failure.
records.proposed_remedy: Not supplied separately in the pasted finding.

evidence.observed: An agents path that could not be enumerated produced Ok(true) and removed the prior sidecar. Individual read_record failures already propagate.
Failure to enumerate the agents path returns a diagnostic and preserves the existing .agents bytes.

records.reachability_basis: Directory enumeration failure alone suffices; no race required.
records.invariant: An incomplete agent inventory must not replace a compatibility projection as though it were complete.
records.smallest_complete_fix: Propagate read_dir and iterator failures before changing the sidecar; preserve missing-directory semantics and existing record-error propagation.
records.risk_if_deferred: False zero/undercount during an I/O failure.
records.risk_if_fixed_now: Confusing a genuinely missing empty directory with an unavailable inventory.
records.action: Implemented and focused proof passed. Propagate read_dir and iterator failures before changing the sidecar; preserve missing-directory semantics and existing record-error propagation.
records.draft_response: Confirmed under the recorded conditions; the complete local correction and focused regressions pass. The full repository gate and isolated timing confirmation now pass.

records.observation: P2 — pi/index.ts:541 retains every queued Pi event behind a permanently blocked state write, with no memory bound.
records.claimed_consequence: Memory can grow while the external write stays blocked. Existing comments disclose it; no ordinary healthy-write leak was demonstrated.
records.proposed_remedy: Not supplied separately in the pasted finding.

evidence.observed: The same mutationChain and documented permanently-blocked-write residual exist at the review base. New observation callbacks increase enqueue volume.

records.reachability_basis: A never-settling head plus continuing events is required; the base already has this failure family.
records.invariant: Best-effort notification work must not retain unbounded queued work during a permanently blocked write.
records.smallest_complete_fix: Design bounded admission/cancellation/reload ownership and recovery together; do not drop FIFO transitions or detach an uncancellable write through a timeout-only patch.
records.risk_if_deferred: Memory can grow while the external write stays blocked. Existing comments disclose it; no ordinary healthy-write leak was demonstrated.
records.risk_if_fixed_now: A local cap or timeout can lose terminal/clear events or allow old-generation writes after recovery.
records.action: Track complete work in docs/plans/BACKLOG.md#bounded-pi-mutation-queue; do not change queue semantics in this patch.
records.draft_response: Confirmed for a never-settling write plus continued events. The mechanism existed at base; increased event volume widens it. A bounded controller needs explicit loss/cancellation/reload/recovery policy, tracked in docs/plans/BACKLOG.md#bounded-pi-mutation-queue. NON-BLOCK is a documented rare-path deferral, not a fix.

records.observation: P2 — src/lib.rs:289 checks mux socket identity before realm publication, but not during its per-pane TTY loop. A socket rebirth can publish a stale realm/incarnation.
records.claimed_consequence: Stale incarnation published to pane user variables.
records.proposed_remedy: Not supplied separately in the pasted finding.

evidence.observed: Rebirth inside TTY fingerprint reached write(), which the fault port rejects as stale publication.
A socket rebirth during per-row fingerprint work produces incarnation_changed and no TTY publication.

records.reachability_basis: Socket replacement after enumeration but before a row write.
records.invariant: Realm identity must still match before each controllable pane publication.
records.smallest_complete_fix: Recheck the socket incarnation after per-pane claim/fingerprint work and immediately before each TTY write; diagnose stale rows.
records.risk_if_deferred: Stale incarnation published to pane user variables.
records.risk_if_fixed_now: Claiming an impossible zero-race atomicity guarantee across socket stat and TTY write.
records.action: Implemented and focused proof passed. Recheck the socket incarnation after per-pane claim/fingerprint work and immediately before each TTY write; diagnose stale rows.
records.draft_response: Confirmed under the recorded conditions; the complete local correction and focused regressions pass. The full repository gate and isolated timing confirmation now pass.

records.observation: P2 — plugin/runtime.lua:366 can retain a closed window’s unpublished-realm retry forever when GUI-window inventory is unavailable.
records.claimed_consequence: Unnecessary publisher subprocesses can continue indefinitely.
records.proposed_remedy: Not supplied separately in the pasted finding.

evidence.observed: After two initial polls, five timer callbacks spawned five more publishers without another live observation.

evidence.locator: tests/auto_clear_spec.lua:C9 a retry needs a new live observation when inventory fails; unpublished mux panes retry on the bounded schedule and stop when resolved
evidence.observed: Stale observations stop autonomous retries; fresh polls restart and renew them; healthy backoff remains 2/5/10/30.

records.reachability_basis: Window closes while inventory is unavailable; retained timer has no subsequent poll from that window.
records.invariant: A retry cannot use an indefinitely old observation as evidence of current unpublished panes.
records.smallest_complete_fix: When global inventory is unavailable, require a new pane poll before another autonomous publication and retire the stale retry observation; fresh polls can restart.
records.risk_if_deferred: Unnecessary publisher subprocesses can continue indefinitely.
records.risk_if_fixed_now: Stopping progress for live panes if normal polls cannot rearm retry.
records.action: Implemented and focused proof passed. When global inventory is unavailable, require a new pane poll before another autonomous publication and retire the stale retry observation; fresh polls can restart.
records.draft_response: Confirmed under the recorded conditions; the complete local correction and focused regressions pass. The full repository gate and isolated timing confirmation now pass.

records.observation: P2 — docs/record-contract.md:39 says every accepted transition is lock-guarded, while Lua acknowledgement and review operations are only per-file atomic operations.
records.claimed_consequence: Downstream developers assume stronger cross-writer serialization than exists.
records.proposed_remedy: Not supplied separately in the pasted finding.

evidence.observed: The document says every accepted transition is lock-guarded; Lua validates then atomically replaces or removes a file without a lock.
The contract now distinguishes Rust lock scopes from Lua atomic per-file operations without Rust locks.

records.reachability_basis: Readers of the documented persistence contract see the overclaim.
records.invariant: The record contract must distinguish Rust lock transactions from Lua atomic per-file operations.
records.smallest_complete_fix: Correct the authoritative contract without claiming Lua acknowledgement/review operations take Rust locks.
records.risk_if_deferred: Downstream developers assume stronger cross-writer serialization than exists.
records.risk_if_fixed_now: Documentation-only change; avoid disguising a separate runtime race as an intentional guarantee.
records.action: Implemented and focused proof passed. Correct the authoritative contract without claiming Lua acknowledgement/review operations take Rust locks.
records.draft_response: Confirmed documentation overclaim. The authoritative record contract now states per-file Lua atomicity without Rust transaction locks.
